label: Building Footprints
description: Extract one polygon per building from a task's orthophoto with the HOT DINOv3 building model (mask + boundary + signed-distance heads). Touching buildings are separated by a watershed on the distance plane, outlines are simplified and near-rectangular ones regularised. Result: GeoJSON footprints with class, score and area, drawn as a layer on the map. Models are cards in models/: swap the card to run a different export.

model.title: Model
model.description: Footprint model to run (a model card in models/). hot-dinov3s-buildings: HOT DINOv3-S building footprints (aerial RGB) (Apache-2.0). Parameters left at 0/-1/auto use the card's recommended values.

resolution_m.title: Processing resolution (m)
resolution_m.description: Ground sample distance of the processing grid the model sees; 0 uses the model's recommended value (0.25 m). Coarser is faster and lets larger areas fit the sandbox's memory budget; finer than ~0.15 m rarely helps.

tile_size.title: Window size (px)
tile_size.description: Side of the windows the model is run on; 0 uses the model's value (fixed at 256 px for the HOT model).

overlap.title: Window overlap (px)
overlap.description: Overlap between neighbouring windows, blended with Gaussian weights so seams do not show; -1 uses the model's value (64). 128 gives the smoothest result at about twice the run time.

confidence.title: Confidence threshold
confidence.description: Minimum building probability for a pixel to count as building; 0 uses the model's value (0.5). Lower finds more (and merges more), higher is stricter.

seed_min_distance.title: Seed spacing (px)
seed_min_distance.description: Small blobs: minimum distance in grid pixels between two seeds (local maxima of the distance plane) before they count as separate buildings; 0 uses the model's value (5).

large_blob_area_px.title: Large blob area (px)
large_blob_area_px.description: Blobs with at least this many grid pixels are seeded with h-maxima (prominence) instead of plain local maxima; 0 uses the model's value (2000). Lower it to use the more robust prominence seeding on smaller blobs too.

h_maxima_depth.title: Seed prominence (h-maxima)
h_maxima_depth.description: Large blobs: a distance maximum must stand out by at least this much (on the model's -1..1 distance scale) to seed a building; 0 uses the model's value (0.1). Higher merges more, lower splits more.

min_area_m2.title: Minimum footprint area (m²)
min_area_m2.description: Footprints smaller than this are dropped; -1 uses the model's value (4 m²), 0 keeps everything.

simplify_m.title: Outline simplification (m)
simplify_m.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance for the footprint outlines; -1 uses the model's value (0.3 m), 0 keeps the raw pixel outline.

regularize_area_threshold.title: Rectangle fill threshold
regularize_area_threshold.description: A footprint filling at least this fraction of its minimum rotated rectangle is replaced by that rectangle; 0 uses the model's value (0.85), 1 disables regularisation.

regularize_overlap_tol_m2.title: Rectangle overlap tolerance (m²)
regularize_overlap_tol_m2.description: A rectangle is only used when it adds at most this much new overlap with neighbouring footprints; -1 uses the model's value (1 m²), 0 allows none.
